title: Multi-omics Analysis Reveals Molecular Subtype of Mitochondrial Oxidative Stress and Prognostic Model Development in Sepsis.

models.verbatim_formula: MOSRG score = CX3CR1 x -2.056 + EPHX2 x -1.720 + RNASE2 x 2.065
models.expression_scale_used: GSE54514+GSE65682+GSE95233 merged and sva batch-corrected (scale unclear)
models.cutoff: optimal cutoff for 28-day outcome (value not reported)

models.outcome_definition: K-means consensus clusters A (n=303) / B (n=176); A longer 28-day survival
models.reported_performance: Survival difference shown in figure (no numeric value)

notes: Full text from publisher PDF (suppl/40613299/paper.pdf). The 479 sepsis samples with prognostic data (matches GSE65682) were split 7:3 (caret) into training/validation; this is internal only. GSE54514 and GSE95233 merged with GSE65682 for WGCNA/DEG (100 NC). Coefficients large, likely on batch-corrected scale. Subtype clustering uses the same 3 genes.
